summary: Reconstructed eight exact degree-eight remainder branches, proved the intrinsic pair-wall coefficient is a nested spline, factored its two beta-selected local polynomial types into compact blocks, found a universal compact same-energy wall trace verified in 17 environments, and exactly rejected naive independent positive-part integration. The remaining obstruction is coupled Mobius/inclusion-exclusion assembly and the global R0.
work_done: Built exact homogeneous on-shell quotient bases of dimensions 285 at degree 8 and 140 at degree 6.
Solved eight full-rank 285-by-285 exact branch systems in four q24-wall environments; all 160 independent exact BG holdouts had zero residual.
Extracted exact H24/H14 polynomials and verified exact q24 divisibility, including the independent wall value 12622720/27.
Proved Hmp is itself a spline using an unequal symmetry-related physical wall polynomial, while isolated q25 and Q1;45 controls leave it unchanged.
Factored the other-minus-beta H piece into three blocks and the other-plus-beta H piece into seven blocks; all 4/4 reconstructed intrinsic-piece checks have zero symbolic residual.
Found Hmp on isolated same-energy walls as -32 beta^2 times one symmetric quartic, beta the minimum magnitude among all four non-primary legs; verified 17/17 environments and 102/102 branch holdouts.
Matched the compact beta selector symbolically to student-1's independent P(u) and P(6-u) branch exchange.
Tested R0_cell=R_cell-sum q_mp,+ H_mp(beta) exactly and found agreement in only 1/8 cells, identifying coupled beta exchanges and the need for Mobius/inclusion-exclusion.
Appended claims s2_007 and s2_008 and board posts post_009, post_011, post_012, and post_013.
next_steps: Construct the Mobius/inclusion-exclusion integration over simultaneous beta-minimum exchanges, using the stored eight branch polynomials as exact constraints.
Recover one cell-independent dual-S3 polynomial R0 and verify it across all reconstructed cells before extending the candidate to fresh BG points.
Only after global assembly passes, combine with P_pole and run the full eight-word, hierarchy, wall, pole-orbit, permutation, and five-point definition-of-done battery.
